items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-07-14
items.q: I learned from the band that my brother was playing in.

ctx.x: So they had music in the quarter, but what kind of music was it?

It was cabaret style. Regular dance music of popular music at the time. The music that was popular at that time. For instance, Yes Sir, That's My Baby. Margie. All of those things. But the things that were already written were some 25 or 30 years the generation before that. stuff very shady, Mahogany Hall was. It's hard for me to go back further than that for the simple reason I am not a native of New Orleans. Had I been a native of New Orleans, I could tell you how it all began, so to speak. But I'm not. I'm a…
Different times. Yeah. You must have learned tunes from your daddy. Oh my lord, yes. Mississippi
